title: Deficiency Board
description: Track remediation and assess severity using the Degree of Deficiency (DoD) model.

form.title: Remediation Action Plan
form.description: Form for planning and tracking control remediation as per SK-5/2024.

placeholders.remediatedControlDescription: How will the control look after remediation?

wizard.title: Degree of Deficiency (DoD) Assessment
wizard.description: Evaluate deficiency severity following Figure 5 (Page 73) of Regulation SK-5/2024.
wizard.aggregateDescription: Evaluate combined impact of selected deficiencies as per Box 7 mandate.

step0.title: Automatic Material Weakness Indicators
step0.description: Certain conditions automatically conclude as Material Weakness (MW) regardless of quantitative impact.
step0.seniorManagementFraud: Fraud by senior management (regardless of materiality)
step0.materialFraudImpact: Fraud resulting in material financial misstatement
step0.restatement: Restatement of previously issued financial statements to reflect the correction of a material misstatement
step0.auditorIdentified: Material misstatement identified by external auditors that was not prevented or detected by internal control
step0.auditCommittee: Ineffective oversight of financial reporting and internal control by the Audit Committee

box1.title: Box 1: Magnitude vs. Likelihood
box1.question: Is there a reasonable possibility that the control deficiency could result in a misstatement that is more than inconsequential?

box2.title: Box 2: Severity vs. Materiality
box2.question: Is the magnitude of the potential misstatement more than significant?

box3.title: Box 3: Material Misstatement Potential
box3.question: Is there a reasonable possibility that the misstatement could be material?
box3.materialWarning: Attention: Exposure is ABOVE PM threshold.

box4.title: Box 4: Compensating Controls
box4.question: Are there other effective compensating controls that would prevent or detect the potential misstatement?

box5.title: Box 5: Significant Deficiency Conclusion
box5.question: Does management conclude that this deficiency represents a Significant Deficiency (SD)?

box6.title: Box 6: Material Weakness Conclusion
box6.question: Does management conclude that this deficiency represents a Material Weakness (MW)?

box7.title: Box 7: Aggregation Loop
box7.question: Is it necessary to aggregate this deficiency with others to evaluate combined impact?

result.title: Assessment Conclusion
result.autoRationale: Automatic Material Weakness due to identified high-risk indicators (Fraud/Restatement/Audit Oversight).
result.flowchartRationale: Severity determined based on systematic Figure 5 flowchart evaluation of magnitude, likelihood, and compensating controls.
result.rationalePlaceholder: Explain the reasoning for this severity conclusion...
result.mwNote: Material Weakness requires reporting to Audit Committee and Board of Commissioners (Table 24).
result.cdNote: Control Deficiency requires remediation monitoring by Process Owner.
